quote: by way of interest that arises through or from the carrying on in Hong Kong by the corporation of its intra-group financing business

name: sum_remitted_counts_as_received_in_hk

name: regime_applies_to_income_accrued_and_received_from

name: non_pure_equity_holding_entity_adequate_operating_expenditure_in_hk
quote: the total amount of operating expenditure incurred in Hong Kong for carrying out the specified economic activities is adequate in the Commissioner’s opinion

name: reference_rate_compared_with_highest_applicable_rate
quote: the highest applicable rate, of a similar tax in that territory is equal to or higher than the reference rate

name: intragroup_transfer_at_no_gain_no_loss
quote: the selling entity is to be regarded as having sold the subject property for a consideration of such amount as would secure that neither a gain nor a loss would accrue to the selling entity
note: s 15OA(3); buyer and seller must be associated and both chargeable to profits tax at the time of sale

name: qualifying_ip_income_excepted_portion_by_nexus
quote: section 15I(1) does not operate in relation to the excepted portion of the income ascertained under Part 2 of Schedule 17FC
note: limited to qualifying IP income, the excepted part computed under Schedule 17FC

name: unilateral_credit_only_for_income_charged_under_s15I
quote: the following condition is specified for the income: the income is chargeable to profits tax because of section 15I(1)
note: the unilateral credit applies only to specified foreign-sourced income chargeable because of s 15I(1); non-equity disposal gains qualify when accrued and received from 2024-01-01

name: underlying_tax_credit_adequate_interest_min
quote: person A has at least 10% of direct or indirect beneficial interest in, or in relation to, person B

name: deemed_sg_source_if_loan_funds_used_in_sg
quote: any income derived from loans where the funds provided by such loans are brought into or used in Singapore

name: recipient_not_resident_in_sg
quote: accruing in or derived from Singapore on or after 1 January 2005 by a person not resident in Singapore

name: not_derived_from_trade_carried_on_in_sg
quote: which is not derived by the person from any trade, business, profession or vocation carried on or exercised by the person in Singapore
note: s 43(3A) contains the same wording; the 10% rate does not apply when not met

name: not_effectively_connected_with_sg_pe
quote: which is not effectively connected with any permanent establishment in Singapore of the person
note: s 43(3A) contains the same wording; the 10% rate does not apply when not met

name: withholding_duty_applies_to_s12_6_7_income
quote: Section 45(1) to (8) applies in relation to the payment of any income referred to in section 12(6) or (7)
note: the deduction, filing deadline and penalty provisions of s 45 also apply to s 12(6), (7) income

name: recipient_resident_non_individual
quote: on or after 1 June 2003 by any person, not being an individual, resident in Singapore
note: s 13(8)(d); must be a foreign dividend received in Singapore

name: exemption_or_concessionary_rate_by_ministerial_order
quote: the income received by a person resident in Singapore from such source in any country outside Singapore as may be specified in the order
note: s 13(12); the Minister may by order exempt in whole or in part or apply a concessionary rate, a specific order is required

name: pure_equity_holding_entity_adequate_people_and_premises_in_sg
quote: the entity has adequate human resources and premises in Singapore to carry out the operations of the entity
note: a pure equity-holding entity must also file the returns required by law and have its business managed and performed in Singapore

name: non_pure_equity_holding_entity_adequate_economic_substance_in_sg
quote: the entity has adequate economic substance in Singapore, taking into account the following considerations
note: the business must also be managed and performed in Singapore; the number of employees, their qualifications and experience, business expenditure and whether key decisions are made in Singapore are considered

name: company_share_situs
quote: any shares in or securities issued by a company, or any right or interest in such shares or securities, are situated where the company is incorporated
note: used to decide whether it is a foreign asset; registered shares go by the location of the register (subsection (15)(i))

name: s10l_applies_to_disposals_from
quote: Subsection (1) applies only to gains from a sale or disposal of a foreign asset that occurs on or after 1 January 2024.
note: s10L(3); the time of disposal is when the asset vests in the transferee (s10L(4)), the model takes the flow date (decision D36)

name: underlying_tax_credit_shareholding_min
quote: owns not less than 25% of the total number of issued shares of the company paying the dividend
note: at that ratio the credit must include the tax the paying company paid on its profits; the Minister may waive the ratio requirement case by case

name: pooling_by_election
quote: the person may elect to be given a pooled credit for that year of assessment in lieu of any 2 or more of those credits
note: from the year of assessment 2012

name: pooling_requires_sg_tax_payable_on_income
quote: the income tax payable under this Act on the income for the year of assessment (before allowance of any credit under this Part) is not nil
note: one of the conditions for pooled credit (s 50C(2)(c))

name: additional_penalty_starts_after_days
quote: within 30 days after the time specified in paragraph (a), an additional penalty of 1%
cross_check: S45 calculator 2026-10-06: additional penalty for 5 complete months, label sg_s45.09; IRAS page example: 2 complete months totalling 490, label sg_iras_ex.02; both consistent
note: the additional penalty of 1% per month starts to run per complete month only when still unpaid 30 days after the due date

name: certificate_of_residence_due
quote: The due date is 31 Mar of the following year if the claim is for a period in the current calendar year
cross_check: S45 calculator 2026-10-06: a 2026 payment prompts 31 Mar 2027, a 2027 payment prompts 31 Mar 2028, consistent, labels sg_s45.01, 11
note: to claim treaty relief the other party's certificate of residence must be submitted by 31 March of the following year

name: excluded_days
quote: if the last day of the period is a Sunday or a public holiday (which days are called in this section excluded days) the period includes the next following day not being an excluded day
cross_check: S45 calculator 2026-10-06: Sunday roll-over see label sg_s45.09; the public holiday 17 May 2027 during the roll-over is excluded, see label sg_s45.11
note: when the last day of a period is a Sunday or public holiday it moves to the next non-excluded day; Saturday is not among them

name: act_due_on_excluded_day_moves_to_next_day
quote: if that day happens to be an excluded day, the act or proceeding is considered as done or taken in due time if it is done or taken on the next day afterwards, not being an excluded day
note: an act required on a given day that is an excluded day is in time if done on the next non-excluded day

name: holiday_on_sunday_next_day_is_holiday
quote: if any day specified in the Schedule falls on a Sunday, the day next following not being itself a public holiday is declared a public holiday in Singapore
note: when a statutory holiday falls on a Sunday, the next day is a public holiday

name: withholding_rate_non_resident_movable_property_rent
quote: tax at the rate of 15% is to be levied and paid on the gross amount of — ( a ) any income referred to in section 12(6); and ( b ) any income referred to in section 12(7)( a ), ( b ) and ( d )
note: s 43(3): rent for movable property under s 12(7)(d) at 15%; royalties under (a), (b) are reduced to 10% by subsection (3A)

name: exempt_if_beneficial_owner_is_listed_government_body
quote: 从缔约国一方取得的利息应在该国免税，如果受益所有人是
note: Article 11(3) as replaced by the Second Protocol; limited to the named governments, central banks and wholly government-owned institutions

name: wholly_government_owned_and_non_commercial
quote: 应为中国政府完全拥有并且不从事商业活动
note: the named institutions must also be wholly owned by the government and not engage in commercial activities

name: royalties_include_equipment_use
quote: 也包括使用或有权使用工业、商业、科学设备
note: the treaty definition of royalties includes payments for the use of equipment

name: equipment_rent_is_royalty
quote: 特许权使用费也包括使用或有权使用工业、商业、科学设备取得的所得，即设备租金
note: STA interpretation of the provision; except the part of a finance lease characterised as interest, and payments for the use of immovable property

name: comptroller_may_allow_other_period
quote: allow any person or class of persons to give notice of the deduction of tax and make payment of the amount so deducted within such other period and subject to such conditions as the Comptroller may determine
note: s 45(2)(a): the Comptroller may allow a person or class of persons to file and pay within another period. Where IRAS practice sets a due date later than the statutory one, the legal authority is here

name: penalty_date_is_15th_or_date_allowed
quote: or such other date as may be allowed under subsection (2)(a), a sum equal to 5% of such amount of tax is payable
note: s 45(4)(a): the penalty runs from the 15 days or the other date allowed by the Comptroller

name: certificate_of_residence_due_prior_years
quote: Within 3 months from the date of WHT submission if the claim is for preceding calendar years
cross_check: S45 calculator 2026-10-06: a 2025 payment queried in 2026 prompts within 3 months of filing, labels sg_s45.12, 13
note: when the year of the payment is earlier than the year of filing, the certificate of residence must be submitted within 3 months after filing

name: hk_certificate_covers_following_calendar_years
quote: 可用作证明该香港居民在该公历年度及其后连续两个公历年度的香港居民身份
note: a certificate of resident status issued by the Hong Kong IRD for a calendar year may be used in the Mainland for that year and the two following consecutive calendar years; it no longer applies once circumstances change

name: hk_certificate_void_after_change_of_circumstances
quote: 不再符合享受《安排》待遇条件，则原适用于该公历年度的居民身份证明书不能用作证明其在情况发生变化后的香港居民身份
note: once residence circumstances change, the original certificate can no longer prove the residence after the change

name: withholding_obligation_date
quote: 扣缴义务发生之日为相关款项实际支付或者到期应支付之日
note: the withholding obligation arises on the date of actual payment or the date payment falls due; falling due means a payable that should be accrued into costs and expenses on an accrual basis (cn.reg.eit#105)

name: withholding_obligation_date_dividend
quote: 相关应纳税款扣缴义务发生之日为股息、红利等权益性投资收益实际支付之日
note: for dividends the withholding obligation arises on the actual payment date, not the due date

name: fx_conversion_rule
value: CNY central parity on the obligation date
quote: 应当按照扣缴义务发生之日人民币汇率中间价折合成人民币
note: amounts denominated in a foreign currency are converted at the RMB central parity on the day the withholding obligation arises; the central parity is published by the China Foreign Exchange Trade System, see tools/fx_cny.py

name: reinvestment_defers_withholding
quote: 用于境内直接投资暂不征收预提所得税政策的适用范围，由外商投资鼓励类项目扩大至所有非禁止外商投资的项目和领域
note: withholding tax is deferred on direct investment in the Mainland by a foreign investor of its distributed profits; the scope is all projects and fields not on the negative list for foreign investment

name: qualifying_investment_forms
quote: 1.新增或转增中国境内居民企业实收资本或者资本公积； 2.在中国境内投资新建居民企业； 3.从非关联方收购中国境内居民企业股权
note: three forms of direct investment; paying up subscribed registered capital also counts as new paid-in capital (cn.sta.2018-53#i1)

name: listed_shares_excluded_unless_strategic
quote: 不包括新增、转增、收购上市公司股份（符合条件的战略投资除外）
note: shares of listed companies do not count, except strategic investments

name: profit_is_actually_distributed_retained_earnings
quote: 境外投资者分得的利润属于中国境内居民企业向投资者实际分配已经实现的留存收益而形成的股息、红利等权益性投资收益
note: must be actually distributed, realised retained earnings

name: funds_move_directly_to_investee
quote: 相关款项从利润分配企业的账户直接转入被投资企业或股权转让方账户，在直接投资前不得在境内外其他账户周转
note: the funds must be transferred directly from the profit-distributing enterprise's account to the investee's or transferor's account; a same-day transfer through a dedicated RMB reinvestment deposit account counts as direct (cn.sta.2018-53#i2)

name: retroactive_claim_years
quote: 可在实际缴纳相关税款之日起三年内申请追补享受该政策，退还已缴纳的税款
note: a deferral not taken may be claimed retroactively with a refund within three years of the payment of the tax

name: recapture_filing_days_after_withdrawal
quote: 在实际收取相应款项后7日内，按规定程序向税务部门申报补缴递延的税款
note: the deferred tax is paid within 7 days of recovering the investment

name: special_reorganisation_keeps_deferral
quote: 被投资企业发生重组符合特殊性重组条件，并实际按照特殊性重组进行税务处理的，可继续享受暂不征收预提所得税政策待遇
note: a special reorganisation does not trigger recapture

name: late_payment_runs_from_profit_payment
quote: 税款延迟缴纳期限自相关利润支付之日起计算
note: when later verification finds the conditions not met, the late-payment period runs from the date the profits were paid

name: recapture_uses_treaty_in_force_at_payment
quote: 仅可适用相关利润支付时有效的税收协定
note: treaty benefits may be claimed on recapture, but under the treaty in force when the profits were paid

name: deferred_tranche_disposed_first
quote: 视为先行处置已享受暂不征税政策的投资
note: a partial disposal is treated as disposing of the deferred part first

name: payer_filing_days_after_payment
quote: 应在实际支付利润之日起7日内，向主管税务机关提交以下资料
note: the profit-distributing enterprise files the withholding report and the information report within 7 days of payment

name: reinvestment_credit_rate
quote: 可按照投资额的10%抵免境外投资者当年的应纳税额，当年不足抵免的准予向以后结转
cross_check: cn.sta.2025-18.interp: the interpretation agrees with the announcement, a choice between 10% and the lower treaty rate
note: 10% of the reinvested amount is credited against the tax payable in the year, the excess carried forward; after 2028-12-31 the balance may still be credited down to zero (#i10)

name: credit_rate_follows_lower_treaty_rate
quote: 税收协定中关于股息、红利等权益性投资收益适用税率低于10%的，按照协定税率执行
note: when the treaty dividend rate is below 10% the credit is computed at the treaty rate (Mainland–Hong Kong qualifying dividends 5%); once chosen the ratio cannot be changed (cn.sta.2025-18#i4)

name: credit_min_holding_months
quote: 境外投资者境内再投资需连续持有至少5年（60个月）以上
note: held continuously for 60 months; counting from the month of the reinvestment date in the 《利润再投资情况表》 (cn.sta.2025-18#i2)

name: investee_in_encouraged_catalogue
quote: 被投资企业从事的产业属于《鼓励外商投资产业目录》所列的全国鼓励外商投资产业目录
note: the investee must be in the Catalogue of Encouraged Industries for Foreign Investment

name: credit_offsets_later_income_from_same_payer
quote: 境外投资者从利润分配企业自利润分配再投资之日以后取得的企业所得税法第三条第三款规定的股息红利、利息、特许权使用费等所得应缴纳的企业所得税
note: the credit can only offset tax on dividends, interest, royalties etc. obtained from the same profit-distributing enterprise after the reinvestment date; several distributing enterprises are pooled separately (cn.sta.2025-18#i5)

name: credit_recapture_filing_days
quote: 应在收回投资后7日内向利润分配企业所在地税务机关申报补缴递延的税款
note: the deferred tax is paid within 7 days of recovering the investment, the carried-forward balance may be credited

name: withdrawal_before_60_months_reduces_credit
quote: 还应按比例减少境外投资者可享受的税收抵免额度
note: recovery before 60 months reduces the credit proportionally, and any excess already used is paid within 7 days

name: credit_fx_rule
value: CNY central parity on the payment date
quote: 按实际支付相关款项之日的汇率中间价折合成人民币
note: a foreign-currency reinvestment is converted at the central parity on the actual payment date

name: holding_stops_at_registration_change_month
quote: 以被投资企业完成股权变更或注销登记手续当月，确认停止计算其持有该再投资被收回部分的时间
note: the holding period ends in the month of the equity change or deregistration; if the consideration is obtained earlier, the month of obtaining it

name: beneficial_owner_via_100pct_owner
quote: 直接或间接持有申请人100%股份的人符合“受益所有人”条件
note: when the applicant does not qualify but a 100% holder does and is a resident of the same jurisdiction or every intermediate tier qualifies, the applicant is treated as the beneficial owner; dividends only

name: general_anti_avoidance
quote: 企业实施其他不具有合理商业目的的安排而减少其应纳税收入或者所得额的，税务机关有权按照合理方法调整
note: lacking a reasonable commercial purpose means having the reduction, exemption or deferral of tax as the main purpose (Implementing Regulations Article 120); overall assessment, corresponds to U(DISCRETION)

name: late_payment_surcharge_per_day
quote: 从滞纳税款之日起，按日加收滞纳税款万分之五的滞纳金
note: a withholding agent paying over late: 0.05% per day

name: sg_bodies_statutory_or_wholly_government_owned_and_non_commercial
quote: 应依照新加坡议会法案规定设立或完全由新加坡政府拥有，并且不从事商业活动
note: additional conditions for the institutions named on the Singapore side (MAS, GIC, statutory bodies); applies when Mainland-sourced interest is paid to a Singapore government institution

name: exempt_if_received_by_other_side_government_or_agreed_body
quote: 发生于一方而为另一方政府或由双方主管当局认同的机构取得的利息，应在该一方免税
note: interest derived by the government or by institutions recognised by both competent authorities is exempt

name: received_in_hk_kinds
quote: the sum is remitted to, or is transmitted or brought into, Hong Kong; (b) the sum is used to satisfy any debt incurred in respect of a trade, profession or business carried on in Hong Kong; or (c) the sum is used to buy movable property
note: the three forms of "received in Hong Kong" in s 15H(5), corresponding to the enumeration values of the dictionary's receipt_kind

name: rd_fraction_uplift
quote: F = QE × 130% QE + NE
note: nexus fraction F = QE×130%/(QE+NE), capped at 100% (Schedule 17FC section 3)

name: rd_fraction_cap
quote: ascertained in accordance with subsection (1) is more than 100%
note: F is taken as 100% when it exceeds 100%

name: participation_entity_resident_or_pe
quote: a Hong Kong resident person; or (ii) a non-Hong Kong resident person who has a permanent establishment in Hong Kong
note: the participation exemption is only given to Hong Kong resident persons or non-residents with a permanent establishment in Hong Kong

name: trading_stock_periods_disregarded
quote: regarded as trading stock for any period are to be disregarded for the purposes of sections 5 and 6 of this Schedule
note: periods during which the shares are treated as trading stock do not count toward the holding period or the 15% test

name: received_in_sg_kinds
quote: any amount from any income derived from outside Singapore which is remitted to, transmitted or brought into, Singapore; ( b ) any amount from any income derived from outside Singapore which is applied in or towards satisfaction of any debt incurred in respect of a trade or business carried on in Singapore; and ( c ) any amount from any income derived from outside Singapore which is applied to purchase any movable property which is brought into Singapore
note: the three forms of "received in Singapore" in s 10(25), the same structure as Hong Kong s15H(5)

name: unilateral_credit_income_kinds
quote: ( c ) any dividend derived from that territory
note: the unilateral credit of s 50A(1) covers dividends, royalties (not borne by a Singapore resident), interest (likewise), s 10L gains and other income; for non-treaty sources such as Hong Kong and Macao

name: corporate_income_tax_rate
quote: 企业所得税的税率为25％
note: statutory rate for resident enterprises

name: reasonable_expense_deductible
quote: 企业实际发生的与取得收入有关的、合理的支出，包括成本、费用、税金、损失和其他支出，准予在计算应纳税所得额时扣除
note: reasonableness is an overall assessment, corresponds to U(DISCRETION)

name: excess_related_party_interest_not_deductible
quote: 企业从其关联方接受的债权性投资与权益性投资的比例超过规定标准而发生的利息支出，不得在计算应纳税所得额时扣除
note: thin capitalisation

name: related_debt_equity_ratio_other_enterprises
quote: 其他企业，为2：1
note: debt-to-equity cap for related-party debt of non-financial enterprises 2:1

name: related_debt_equity_ratio_financial_enterprises
quote: 金融企业，为5：1
note: financial enterprises 5:1

name: excess_interest_deductible_if_arms_length
quote: 证明相关交易活动符合独立交易原则的；或者该企业的实际税负不高于境内关联方的，其实际支付给境内关联方的利息支出，在计算应纳税所得额时准予扣除
note: interest above the ratio remains deductible when the arm's-length principle is shown; overall assessment

name: outgoings_in_production_of_profits_deductible
quote: there shall be deducted all outgoings and expenses to the extent to which they are incurred during the basis period for that year of assessment by such person in the production of profits
note: general deduction under s 16(1)

name: outgoings_wholly_exclusively_in_production_deductible
quote: there are to be deducted all outgoings and expenses wholly and exclusively incurred during that period by that person in the production of the income
note: general deduction under s 14(1)

name: last_day_on_public_holiday_rolls
quote: 期限的最后一日是法定休假日的，以休假日期满的次日为期限的最后一日
note: Article 109 of the Implementing Rules: when the last day falls on a statutory holiday, extended to the day after the holiday ends

name: consecutive_holiday_days_extend_by_count
quote: 在期限内有连续３日以上法定休假日的，按休假日天数顺延
note: when a period contains 3 or more consecutive days of statutory holiday, extended by that number of days

name: map_requires_action_of_other_authority
quote: 缔约对方所采取的措施，已经或将会导致不符合税收协定所规定的征税行为
note: mutual agreement is directed at the measures of the other side's tax authority

name: no_reacceptance_after_withdrawal_or_refusal
quote: 申请人撤回申请或者拒绝接受缔约双方主管当局达成一致的相互协商结果的，税务机关不再受理基于同一事实和理由的申请
note: after a withdrawal or refusal, a request on the same facts is not accepted again

name: objection_months_after_notice_of_assessment
quote: received by the Commissioner within 1 month after the date of the notice of assessment
note: s 64(1): written objection within 1 month of the notice of assessment

name: appeal_months_after_determination
quote: 1 month after the transmission to him under section 64(4) of the Commissioner’s written determination
note: s 66(1): appeal to the Board of Review within 1 month of service of the Commissioner's determination

name: objection_months_company
quote: if the person is a company and the notice of assessment is served on the person on or after 1 January 2014, 2 months
note: s 76(3)(a): a company objects within 2 months of service of the notice of assessment

name: pay_or_secure_before_review
quote: 必须先依照税务机关的纳税决定缴纳或者解缴税款及滞纳金或者提供相应的担保，然后可以依法申请行政复议
note: tax disputes: reconsideration must precede litigation, pay the tax or provide security first

name: review_days_after_knowing
quote: 可以自知道或者应当知道该行政行为之日起六十日内提出行政复议申请
